hook.line: Everyone talks about Claude Code, but nobody shows you how to set it up.
hook.visual: Face in a cap in the top half over a dark Claude Code screen, with a white 'Setup Claude Code in 60 seconds' title and orange 'least scary & easiest method' tag

beats.what: Face top, Claude Code screen bottom, '60 seconds' title promise
'Three, two, one, let's go' countdown: cut to full-frame face laughing
Split screen returns with a visible countdown timer over the seam; step one, Claude pricing page
Google search result for Visual Studio Code being clicked
Mid-video ask: comment 'help' for the full walkthrough
Extensions panel in VS Code, searching for Claude Code
Zoom punch on the extension page as he points to 6.5 million installs as proof
Typing /login in the Claude Code panel, shown big in the middle
Authorize step and quick cuts to the end

why_it_works: Countdown timer on screen turns the '60 seconds' promise into a visible race, so viewers watch to see it hit zero
Fear removal in the title ('least scary') targets beginners who think coding tools are hard
Face stays visible on top while the screen shows each click, so trust and instruction run at the same time
Social proof inside the demo (install count) answers 'is this safe?' before the viewer asks
weaknesses: The '60 seconds' promise is broken: the video runs about 81 s
One shot runs about 65 s; motion comes only from the screen recording and two zoom punches
Ends abruptly on a screen with no closing face line
for_robert: Put a visible countdown or step timer on screen when promising speed; Fred could carry or tap the timer as it ticks.
